title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the 43rd Batch of Guiding Cases
keywords_en: State compensation; Compensation for injury caused by illegal use of weapons; Supreme People's Court; Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region; Natural person; State organ; State Compensation Law; State liability for compensation for injury caused by illegal use of weapons; Illegal use of weapons; Compensation for personal injury; Unifying adjudication standards; Clarifying judicial standards
full_text_en:
The Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 43rd Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2024] No. 302

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon deliberation and decision by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the following seven cases (Guiding Cases No. 241–247), including the case of *Huang v. Pingguo County Public Security Bureau of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region — compensation for injury caused by illegal use of weapons*, are hereby issued as the 43rd batch of guiding cases for reference in the adjudication of similar cases.

December 23, 2024
